title: papurika result document
description: The JSON document papurika's --output json|yaml emits. Within this version, properties may be ADDED and the open vocabularies may gain values, so a consumer must ignore what it does not recognize; nothing is renamed, removed, or redefined. --output ndjson is a different, streaming shape and is not described here.

Command.title: Command
Command.description: One command's outcome. A minion-targeting command fills minions; a master-side (runner/wheel) command fills value instead and leaves minions absent. targeted == 0 distinguishes them.

client.description: The salt-api client that ran it (local, local_async, local_batch, runner, wheel, ssh, ...).

extra_jids.description: Remaining job ids when one command covers several jobs — a client-side-batched run, where each chunk is its own job merged into this view. Use summary.jids to get them all without special-casing.

fun.description: The salt function that was run.

index.description: Position of this command in the request.

jid.description: Job id, when the command produced one. Absent for synchronous clients, which salt-api does not give a jid.

minions.description: Per-minion outcomes, sorted by id. Absent for a master-side command.

retcode.description: Command-level return code, when salt reported one.

targeted.description: Minion ids the job was dispatched to, as salt reported them.

value.description: Return of a master-side (runner/wheel) command, verbatim. Any JSON.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: A request-level failure: authentication, transport, a malformed request, or the clock running out. Per-minion outcomes are never reported here — those are a minion status plus a retcode.

kind.description: Failure class. Open vocabulary; "error" is the catch-all.

message.description: Human-readable description. Not a stable string; branch on kind, or on the process exit code.

Minion.title: Minion
Minion.description: One minion's outcome. A command that ran and failed is status "responded" with a non-zero retcode — failure is not a separate status, so "the minion answered" and "the thing it ran worked" stay separate questions.

retcode.description: Return code, or null when the minion reported none. Null and 0 are different facts, which is why this property is always present rather than omitted.

return.description: The minion's return value, exactly as salt sent it. Any JSON — shape depends on the function; a state run returns a map of state id to result, or an array of error strings if the run never started.

status.description: Whether and how the minion answered. Open vocabulary. "noresponse" is a claim (probed and found absent); "pending" is the absence of one (has not answered yet) — treating pending as failure reports a healthy in-flight job as broken.

commands.description: One entry per command in the request, in order. Never null; an empty document carries an empty array.

error.description: Set when the request itself failed. Present both on a document that gathered nothing (summary.outcome is "error") and on a partial one that was cut short, where the outcome describes what was gathered and this says what stopped it.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Check this before trusting the rest of the document.

summary.description: Every minion of every command, folded into one set of counts.

Summary.title: Summary
Summary.description: Aggregate counts across every command. targeted = returned + noresponse + pending; returned = succeeded + failed.

failed.description: Minions that answered with a non-zero retcode or a per-minion error.

jids.description: Every job id the run touched, including each chunk of a batched run. These stay recoverable with `papurika watch <jid>` whatever else happened.

noresponse.description: Minions probed with saltutil.find_job and found not running the job.

outcome.description: Overall outcome. Open vocabulary — branch on the values you handle and keep a default.

pending.description: Minions with no terminal outcome yet. Distinct from noresponse: nothing has been concluded about them.

returned.description: Minions that answered, whether or not the command succeeded.

succeeded.description: Minions that answered with a zero or absent retcode.

targeted.description: Minions the command(s) were dispatched to. 0 for a master-side (runner/wheel) command.
